question: Will Bitcoin trade above $67,000 before August 25, 2026 (UTC)?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the BTC/USDT spot price on Binance reaches or exceeds $67,000 at any point from market open up to and including the market close on Aug 25, 2026, 23:59 UTC (i.e., a trade or mark price of $67,000.00 or above is recorded at or before that time).
- "No": Wins if the BTC/USDT spot price on Binance does not reach $67,000 at any point up to and including the market close on Aug 25, 2026, 23:59 UTC, remaining strictly below $67,000.00 throughout that entire window.
